name: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk
summary: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automotive components and metal finishing for motorcycles and cars in Indonesia. The company offers frame body, muffler, wheel rim, steering handle, grab rail, main stand, step bar component, swing arm, arm cushion, and fastener for motorcycles and reinforcement sub assy instrument panel and beam comp steering hanger, hood lock, cross member frame, general parts, and suspension member for automobiles.
